source: Microsoft Word 16.113.2 PDF export; points from the page top. imageTops are the images' tops, bottomBTop the last line's top (baseline minus the 11.3pt ascent of a 12pt Arial line). img-cell-300: a one-cell table (Normal style 1.25 lines, 8pt after) holding a text line, an image alone on its line and a text line; bottomATop is the top of the paragraph after the table.
